Penguins are birds..why: Stated in the first sentence of Wikipedia's article.

Bats are birds..why: False: bats are mammals, the only mammals capable of true flight.

notes: RBox contraction paired with biology-replace-0010: removes the property ('is a lobe of' is a subproperty of 'is part of'), so every query expects 'does not know'. The propositional questions follow strong Kleene logic. The two derived instances give their premises in the prompt and ask about the conclusion; hops counts those premises as one bridge. Unrelated near asks the same kind of property of another relation, which stays as it was (contraction is exempt from Rule 7); unrelated far asks about an unrelated relation.
